name: ring-mcp
description: Ring Security Ecosystem MCP - Universal control for Ring doorbell, burglar alarm, fire alarm, and cameras
long_description: Ring MCP Server provides complete integration with Ring security devices including cameras, doorbells, security systems, and fire safety devices. Features real-time device monitoring, live streaming, alarm control, and comprehensive system management using FastMCP 2.12.0.

ring_token.title: Ring API Token
ring_token.description: Ring API token (optional - will be generated from username/password if not provided)

tools.name: get_devices
tools.description: Get a list of all Ring devices connected to your account

tools.name: get_device_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Ring device

tools.name: get_device_events
tools.description: Get recent events for a specific Ring device (motion, doorbell, etc.)

tools.name: get_live_stream_url
tools.description: Get a live stream URL for a Ring camera device

tools.name: set_arm_status
tools.description: Arm or disarm a Ring security system

tools.name: trigger_chime

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check the health and connectivity of the Ring MCP service

tools.name: get_system_status
tools.description: Get overall status of all Ring devices and systems

tools.name: get_recent_events

tools.name: get_battery_levels

prompts.name: security-system-analysis
prompts.description: Comprehensive analysis of Ring security system status and recommendations
prompts.text: Perform a comprehensive analysis of the Ring security system. Include device status, event analysis, system health assessment, and actionable recommendations. Use the security-system-analysis.json template for detailed guidance.

prompts.name: device-troubleshooting
prompts.description: Step-by-step troubleshooting guide for Ring device issues
prompts.text: Troubleshoot a Ring device issue with systematic diagnosis. Follow the device-troubleshooting.json template for comprehensive problem resolution steps.

prompts.name: morning-security-check
prompts.description: Daily morning security system status check and briefing
prompts.text: Perform a morning security briefing for the Ring system. Check all device statuses, review overnight activity, and provide security recommendations. Follow the morning-security-check.json template.

prompts.name: emergency-response
prompts.description: Emergency response protocol activation and coordination
prompts.text: Activate emergency response protocol for Ring security system. Coordinate immediate security actions, evidence collection, and emergency notifications. Use the emergency-response.json template for critical incident response.

prompts.name: camera-management
prompts.description: Comprehensive camera system management and optimization
prompts.text: Manage and optimize Ring camera systems. Perform status checks, maintenance, and configuration optimization. Follow the camera-management.json template for comprehensive camera management.

prompts.name: system-monitoring
prompts.description: Continuous system health monitoring and performance tracking
prompts.text: Monitor Ring security system health and performance continuously. Track system metrics, security events, and predictive maintenance needs. Use the system-monitoring.json template for detailed monitoring analysis.
